defs.def: to move back or away from a place or situation; to make sb/sth do this （使）撤回，撤离

ex.s: This does not The person who withdraws The person says nothing and tries to feels the situation.
ex.t: 这样说不对 退避的人 这个人什么也不说，试图去感受（体会）当时的情形。

defs.def: to stop giving or offering sth to sb 停止提供；不再给予

ex.s: After I lost my right hand in a car accident two years ago, I began to withdraw into myself, believing I would never be able to lead a normal life again.
ex.t: 两年前在一场车祸中失去右手后，我开始自我封闭，相信自己再也无法过上正常的生活。

defs.def: to stop taking part in an activity or being a member of an organization; to stop sb/sth from doing these things （使）退出

ex.t: 一些参与者退出了研究。

defs.def: to take money out of a bank account 提，取（银行账户中的款）
to say that you no longer believe that sth you previously said is true 收回，撤回，撤销（说过的话）

ex.s: Oh I cannot do it; therefore forgive me when you see me withdraw when I would have gladly joined you in conversation.
ex.t: 哦，我做不到；所以当你们看到我退缩时，请原谅我，尽管我本很高兴地与你们交谈。

ex.s: I would then rush to visit you; whereas, as it is, I must withdraw from everything.
ex.t: 那样的话我就会赶去探望你；然而事实上，我必须从一切中抽身退避。

defs.def: to become quieter and spend less time with other people 脱离（社会）；不与人交往
